scope: alpha-next stop-fix matrix (harness/test_alpha_next_stopfix_matrix.py): fix 1 and fix 2 per driver (stepped, fused, grouped, C0 staged) and the item-1 stop receipts; hub CPU tests; no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: pending-peer-endpoint
leaves.replaces: a TP peer whose lane submission credit refuses a command (typed E3Pending before any enqueue)
leaves.equivalence: Step B's declared PendingPeer: the peer bridge answers a typed pending SegmentAcceptance for the chosen kind, consuming no op_seq and enqueuing nothing, on the same reply path a credit refusal takes; with defer cleared the real bridge accepts the same command
leaves.cannot_prove: device-side waiting of the accepted peer in its collective

leaves.name: busy-dispatcher
leaves.replaces: the same credit refusal, on the C0 staged network
leaves.equivalence: as test_e3_stopfix_partial_segment.Base.busy (alpha_stopfix_fixture_leaves.json): the target rank's real dispatcher raises E3Pending for the first n submits of one kind in the first chunk, before calling the real submit

leaves.name: fused-latch-at-refused-open
leaves.replaces: a fused chunk whose continuation open the ring refused
leaves.equivalence: fix 1 acts in NativeSegmentDriver._drive_stop at phase 'open' before any segment exists; the open request's qsa_fused flag never reaches a worker on this path (the open was refused) and the only fused-dependent code the stop reaches is _stop_round's time bound (_fused_stop_round), which runs because _tx_fused is set; the stepped network's QSA-free workers are therefore equivalent for this state
leaves.cannot_prove: a fused chunk's own refused open on a network with QSA stacks

leaves.name: fused-stop-clock
leaves.replaces: wall time elapsing past FusedQsa.stall_s during a fused stop
leaves.equivalence: _fused_stop_round reads only self.clock() differences against stall_s; a counting clock with stall_s 0 exhausts the bound on the second round, the same branch a real stall reaches

leaves.name: stop-receipt-logger
leaves.equivalence: the driver writes each stop receipt as one INFO message through _progress_logger(); the capture handler records the formatted message unchanged
leaves.cannot_prove: the container log path; PLAN section 2's writer and its witness cover that
